g4ela-28-1-morphology: Three more Latin bases. Spect means look, so to respect someone is to look up to them. Ject means throw, so eject means throw out. Script and scribe mean write, and a scribe is a person whose job is writing. Find the base, and the word starts to explain itself.
g4ela-28-2-grammar: A complex sentence leans on a little word like because, although, when or if. Because Peter was worn out, he answered shortly. The because part can’t stand alone. It leans on the rest. When it comes first, put a comma after it.
g4ela-28-3-spelling: Schwa is the lazy uh sound in a word. You can’t hear which vowel it is. So find a cousin of the word where the vowel is loud. Opposite sounds like uh in the middle. But oppose says its o clearly. So opposite has an o.
g4ela-28-4-grammar: Editing day. Read each line out loud. Does it stand on its own? Because it was raining. That’s a piece, not a sentence. Does it run two sentences together with no joint? Fix the piece, mend the joint, and say why.
